risks.title: China-related trade restrictions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted in the MD&A introduction as potentially significantly impacting operations, particularly in China. The language is strong (significantly impact, adversely affect). The decline in revenue from Chinese customers in 2025 confirms material impact. Increased prominence versus prior year due to escalating geopolitical tensions. Geopolitical category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Decline in PCB/Display demand
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions significant impairment charges in 2024 and 2025 due to deteriorating outlook for PCB and Display businesses. Language is alarming (continued deterioration, downward revision). Decision to exit the Display market. Direct impact on asset values.

risks.title: Recurring goodwill impairment
risks.score_rationale: Repeated goodwill impairments ($230M in 2025, $192M in 2024). The text indicates high sensitivity to growth assumptions and discount rates. Risk of further write-downs if forecasts decline.

risks.title: Uncertain accounting estimates
risks.score_rationale: The risk covers several critical areas (revenue, inventory, taxes, deferred tax). The text emphasizes the subjective and inherently uncertain nature of judgments. Direct impact on results and margins.

risks.title: Customer and geographic concentration
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of customer concentration and heavy reliance on Asia. The text directly links this to revenue volatility. Risk amplified by geopolitical tensions. Central position in the Results section.

risks.title: Sensitive internal restructuring
risks.score_rationale: An internal reorganization in 2025 triggered impairment tests. The text links the restructuring to changes in reporting units. Risk of operational disruptions or poor integration.

risks.title: Unusable California tax credits
risks.score_rationale: The provision amount ($310M) is significant. The text explains that California tax rules prevent future use of the credits. Risk of outright loss if unresolved.

risks.title: Impact of tariffs and protectionist measures
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A explicitly states that recent tariffs imposed by the U.S. government had a negative impact on results. Impact described as immaterial in 2025 but with uncertainty on duration and magnitude. Positive outlook expected with cost management.

ai_positioning.summary: KLAC references AI and HPC applications indirectly through increased investments in process control for advanced technologies (2-nanometer) and packaging applications for AI and high-performance computing.
evidence: Demand for advanced semiconductor technologies, particularly evident in the 2-nanometer node, which is seeing higher levels of investment and process control intensity, continues to drive investments in AI
Increasing complexity and value of semiconductor packages, particularly for AI and HPC applications, is also driving significant growth in our advanced packaging business
